SPIREECONOMY-BLACK_MARKET_EVENT.title: Black Market
SPIREECONOMY-BLACK_MARKET_EVENT.pages.IN: A hooded broker opens a case of goods that never appeared on any honest ledger.
SPIREECONOMY-BLACK_MARKET_EVENT.pages.MA: Rare merchandise glints beneath the counter. The prices are outrageous, but credit is available.
Purchase this Rare relic. Any shortfall becomes debt.
Purchase this Rare card. Any shortfall becomes debt.
Offer an eligible relic to the broker.
SPIREECONOMY-BLACK_MARKET_EVENT.pages.SE: The broker inspects the relics that can be removed safely.
The broker shakes their head. None of your relics are safe to sell.
SPIREECONOMY-BLACK_MARKET_EVENT.pages.LE: The case snaps shut, and the broker disappears into the crowd.
